about: The trainer AI sends in a Pokemon whose ability swallows the move that hit it (ov10_0221FE8C): Whitney's Furret, hit by a Breloom's Absorb, is switched for her Farigiraf, whose Sap Sipper eats Grass moves. Retail's check knew only Flash Fire, Water Absorb and Volt Absorb; Lightning Rod, Storm Drain, Sap Sipper, Earth Eater and Well-Baked Body go the same way. Furret is left only Body Slam (teach:), so no super-effective move keeps it in and no U-turn sends in another.
